ENGLISH MARCH — TERMLY EXAM #4
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: ENGLISH MARCH
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

----

   A. Avoid reading anything related to Listening and Speaking 1.1.2 Speaking: Etiquette.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Listening and Speaking 1.1.2 Speaking: Etiquette.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening and Speaking 1.1.2 Speaking: Etiquette.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Listening and Speaking 1.1.2 Speaking: Etiquette.

2. Choose the correctly punctuated sentence. (1 mark)
   A. Where is the library
   B. Where is the library?
   C. Where is the Library
   D. where is the library
